The stomach appeared fluid-filled with dilated loops of bowel and with distal bowel loops decompressed, and no exact transition point was seen (Figure 1). There was also right hydroureteronephrosis without a well-defined transition point, though the ureter appeared tapered and extrinsically compressed in the region of the mass (Figure 2).
